# all 8 dihedral orientations

for refl in range(2):
 for rot in range(4):
  pts=[]
  for r,c in shape:
   if refl: c=-c
   for _ in range(rot): r,c=c,-r
   pts.append((r,c))
  mr=min(r for r,c in pts); mc=min(c for r,c in pts)
  orients.add(frozenset((r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in pts))

 for r in range(15-h+1):
  for c in range(22-w+1):
   if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in s):
    paint.update((r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in s)
# only paint zeros of matches, marker removed

print(len(paint))

print(','.join('['+','.join(map(str,row))+']' for row in grid)+']}')
